title: Happy Independence Day, Moldova!
body_html:
“A free and independent state cannot exist without free,

respected and secure people.”

Congratulations on the anniversary of the Independence Day of the Republic of Moldova!

For our incredibly beautiful, hospitable and welcoming country, this day symbolises freedom and prosperity for all of us.

Independence Day is a special occasion for any country and its citizens.

May Moldova’s sky always be clear and bright for many years to come, and may its citizens be united, like a real family.

We wish our country, with its great prospects and rich history, to live independently and to prosper, and its citizens to live in well-being. We wish every family and every home harmony, peace, understanding and prosperity.

May Moldova’s European future be peaceful and happy!
